title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Look at the pattern of the data points in the scatterplot. Consider how the function $$f(x)=x^2$$ might transform the x-values and how this transformation could help fit the data with a quadratic model.

title: Choosing the Right Function
text: Which function, when applied to $$x$$, would allow the model to fit the data points in a quadratic manner?
